subtitle: Caddie scores. Gang follows.
promotionalText: Playing with your caddie? Let them do the scoring and let the gang follow their score. Caddie scoring, live following and Apple Watch, all in one scorecard.
description:
Playing with your caddie? Let them do the scoring and let the gang follow their score. You see the group on your Apple Watch. The Marker is a hole-by-hole scorecard for one to four golfers. No account is needed to keep score: open it, choose a course and tee off. Caddie scoring and live following need a membership in a golf group on The Scorecard; your caddie and followers need no account.

SCORE YOUR WAY
- Enter all four golfers on one screen, or one golfer at a time.
- 18 holes, front nine or back nine, starting on any hole.
- Running totals, Out, In and score to par for every golfer.
- Fix a score before you finish.

LET A CADDIE KEEP THE CARD
- Your caddie joins the card on their own phone with a short code or by pointing the camera at a square code.
- The caddie enters the scores; you check the card and finish it.

LET OTHERS FOLLOW LIVE
- Share a follow code, and friends and family watch the card fill in as scores are entered.
- Followers can only look; nothing can be changed.

YOUR GROUP ON YOUR APPLE WATCH
- Tap Send to my watch on the iPhone.
- See all four golfers on the current hole, swipe through each golfer, and turn the Digital Crown to look back at earlier holes.
- Add your score to your watch face, or the whole group to the Smart Stack.

COURSES
- Search for your course online, or enter one yourself.
- Take a picture of the club's scorecard and The Marker reads the holes, pars and yardages for you to check.

SHARE THE CARD
- Send the finished card by WhatsApp, email or text message.

WORKS WITH THE SCORECARD
If your group uses The Scorecard for handicaps, sign in with the same account and post finished rounds straight to it.

No ads. No tracking.
reviewNotes:
Thank you for reviewing The Marker.

Scoring a round needs no sign-in: on the first screen, tap Play without an account, then Start a new round. Choose a course and tee, tap Choose the players, add up to four names, then tap Tee off on hole 1. Tap a number to enter each golfer's strokes.

Following, caddie scoring and sending your own card to the watch are for members of a golf group, so please use the sign-in in the Sign-in information section: tap Sign in with The Scorecard and enter that email and password.

Follow a card: during the round, tap Menu, then Let others follow this card. A code and square code appear. On a second device, open The Marker (no sign-in needed), tap Follow at the bottom of the first screen and type the code. The card fills in read-only as scores are entered.

Caddie scoring: when choosing players, tap Let my caddie score. On a second device, open The Marker (no sign-in needed), tap Caddie and type the code. The caddie enters the scores.

Apple Watch: with a paired Apple Watch, tap Send to my watch on the follow screen. The watch app shows the group, each golfer and a summary; its widgets show the score on the watch face and in the Smart Stack.

Because these features need more than one device, the attached video shows them on real devices: first the iPhone, then the Apple Watch.

The camera and photo library are used only when the golfer chooses to read a club scorecard from a picture. Before the first picture is sent to Cloudflare's AI for reading, the app asks for permission; the picture is not kept.

The Scorecard is a separate golf handicap app by the same developer. Members can post finished rounds to their group from The Marker.
